Name: Ouranio Recordings Music Pack
Author: Michikawa
Description:
This music pack replaces most of the game music with new .ogg files from various artists belonging to Ouranio Recordings indie roster. Installation requires the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043/]Custom Music mod[/url] as the base integration structure for it to work. This mod only contains multiple ogg files and two json files that are based on the Custom Music mod templates. If you require assistance regarding the installation, please refer to the Custom Music mod creator as he has the knowledge regarding how the integration works. This mod just gives you the .ogg options and json to use.

You can preview the music via [url=https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6R6zzuxW8puRf6IA4R91xc]this Stardew Valley Music Pack playlist[/url]
